listing.name: PlayStation All-Stars Battle Royale — allstars-ps3 (ColinGamez)
listing.summary: The project reports startup reaching FIOS and Direct3D 12, then stalling on an invalid worker condition. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA BCUS98472 disc and its matching .dkey to prepare a decrypted EBOOT and PS3_GAME virtual file system.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the project’s source-build instructions for PPU/SPU code translation with CMake, Ninja, Visual Studio and LLVM. This is a development route; a game startup currently stalls on an invalid worker condition.

warnings: The project reports startup reaching FIOS and Direct3D 12, then stalling on an invalid worker condition.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
